stem: In contrast to serial ports, parallel ports transmit

options.B: single stream of data at a time.
options.C: multiple streams of data at a time.

explanation: Parallel ports transmit multiple bits (streams) of data simultaneously across multiple parallel wire lines (typically 8 bits at a time), whereas serial ports send data 1 bit at a time over a single line.

option_feedback.reason: Parallel ports transfer multiple bits per clock cycle, achieving higher short-distance throughput than legacy serial ports.
Transmitting a single stream of data bit-by-bit is the defining characteristic of a serial port.
Internal system buses—not external parallel peripheral ports—transfer data between the processor and main memory.

options.A: It is a secondary storage device.
options.B: It uses optical disks to store data.
options.C: It is a non-volatile storage device.
options.D: It uses random access method to access the data.

explanation: Statement B is FALSE because a Hard Disk Drive (HDD) stores data magnetically on spinning metal platters, whereas CDs, DVDs, and Blu-ray drives use laser-read optical discs.

option_feedback.reason: An HDD is a primary example of a secondary (auxiliary) storage device; this statement is true.
An HDD retains data permanently without power (non-volatile); this statement is true.

current_mapping.description: describe network topologies (bus, star, ring, mesh, tree, and hybrid) along with their advantages and disadvantages;

stem: Which of the following statements is TRUE about star topology?

options.B: Easiest network topology to set up
options.C: Lowest cost topology to implement due to short cable length
options.D: Failure of one computer does not stop the functioning of the entire network

explanation: In a star topology, each computer has its own dedicated cable to the central switch/hub, so the failure of any single computer or its cable does not disrupt the rest of the network.

option_feedback.reason: Fault detection in star topology is very easy because each link is isolated at the central switch/hub.
Bus topology is simpler to wire initially than running individual cables from every node to a central switch.
Star topology requires more cable than bus topology and requires purchasing a central hub or switch.

P2P file-sharing protocols can operate across connections.

options.A: increase the data rate of the medium.
options.B: stop signals reaching to unauthorised users.
options.C: stop signals from bouncing back to the medium.
